title: HR Executive
description:
Manage recruitment, candidate screening, interview scheduling, and employee onboarding.
Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and other HR documentation.
Maintain employee records, attendance, leave data, and payroll-related information.
Coordinate employee induction, performance reviews, probation, and confirmation processes.
Communicate company policies and handle employee queries and grievances.
Manage employee engagement, training coordination, and exit formalities.
Prepare HR reports, maintain confidentiality, and support compliance with company policies.

title: Relationship Manager
description: Manage customer relationships, understand property requirements, recommend suitable properties, coordinate property visits, and follow up with prospects to drive successful closures. Maintain accurate CRM records, coordinate with internal teams for documentation and transactions, resolve customer queries, submit daily reports, and achieve assigned sales targets.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Identify new business opportunities, develop lead generation strategies, and expand the company's customer base across property management, rentals, leasing, sales, and investments. Build relationships with property owners, tenants, buyers, investors, and business partners. Manage the sales pipeline, monitor lead conversion, support negotiations, and drive successful closures. Guide and coordinate with Business Development Executives and Relationship Managers to achieve team targets. Analyse market trends, identify growth opportunities, maintain accurate sales reports, prepare revenue forecasts, and report business performance to management. Ensure transparent customer communication and achieve assigned monthly revenue and business development targets.

title: Business Development Executive
description: Generate leads through property portals, online platforms, referrals, and other sources, and contact prospective property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers. Qualify leads, introduce company services, follow up with prospects, coordinate property visits, update lead records, support closures, and achieve assigned lead generation and sales targets.
